## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/joe-mott--nell-harcourt.md)

[Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) serves as a student under Joe Mott. Although they do not directly interact in recorded events, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) maintains close ties with Joe's relative, Captain Saul, visiting him at the [Seven Gulls Point](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-point) lighthouse and reading through his written life log.

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P17](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P38](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0038), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P46](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0046), +10 more_

### [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/joe-mott--uncle-saul.md)

[Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) is Joe Mott's uncle, also known as Captain Saul. [Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) resides at the [Seven Gulls Point](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-point) lighthouse, where he collects curiosities, shares stories of his life at sea with visitors, and maintains a written life log detailing his adventurous past.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P20](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0020), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P38](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0038), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P46](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0046), +13 more_

- Relative of — uncle to nephew Joe (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P20](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0020), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P7](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER P20](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0020), +1 more</sub>
